# E0143: a schema or lens refers to a package that is not one of CUE's builtins

A schema refers to a definition in another package of the author's module.
Only CUE's builtin packages may be referred to (reference rule ref-import):
the other package can change without the lineage's file changing, so a
published version's meaning would not be fixed by the lineage. The schema
declares the definition itself.

## Example

`cue.mod/module.cue`:

```cue
module: "example.com/m"
language: version: "v0.9.0"
```

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
package m

import "example.com/m/common"

lin: {
	name: "ship"
	schemas: {
		"0": "0": {
			schema: {c: common.#Color}
		}
	}
}
```

`common/common.cue`:

```cue
package common

#Color: "red" | "blue"
```

`data.json`:

```json
{"c": "red"}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0143]: c in schema 0.0 refers to common.#Color, in package "example.com/m/common", which is not one of CUE's builtin packages
 --> lineage.cue:9:16
  |
9 |             schema: {c: common.#Color}
  |                         ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: reference rule ref-import
  = help: a schema may refer only to its own body and CUE's builtin packages
```
